features.calendar: Complete market calendar; missing factors explicit 0+mask, no synthetic quotes/returns; seasoned resumed stocks remain predictable
features.adjustment: Actual daily adj_factor; no future month-end interpolation
features.stage_labels: Past-only weak context: breakout, reversal, continuation, range
features.universe: All supplied SH/SZ boards including ChiNext and STAR; buy restriction is execution-only
features.scaling: Fixed clipping bounds here; train-only standardization in model
features.theme_selection: Strongest self-free peer return20 - .02*log(observed theme size); at least five feature-valid stocks; no named theme gate
features.theme_unknown: Zero context plus known_theme_context=0; stocks are not excluded
features.theme_causality: Latest whole historically available snapshot; current completed features only; no target in selection
features.amount_role: Raw same-session traded amount relative to selected theme average, not a market-cap proxy

checkpoint_format: Pickled LightGBM boosters; .pt is artifact name only

reference_protocol.reference: Equal mean of available current own trailing return_h and selected self-free theme peer trailing return_h; one if only one exists, zero if neither
reference_protocol.availability: Explicit encoded availability masks; unknown selected theme context is unavailable, not an observed zero return
reference_protocol.return_training_target: Actual next-open future native return_h minus the causal signal-day reference_h
reference_protocol.return_inference: Saved learned residual_h plus current signal-day reference_h; negative residual corrections retained without clipping
reference_protocol.downside_target: Unchanged true future maximum adverse excursion
reference_protocol.rally_target: Unchanged true future return >= (.10,.15,.30); never threshold residual return
reference_protocol.hyperparameters: Same V3 masked factors and fixed 120-round tree ceiling, early stop12, purged quarters; no parameter sweep or stock/theme/month filter

factor_inputs: Unchanged finite/masked V3 daily tree factors
experts: Separate residual-return, true-risk and true-event tree heads; not neural experts
validation: Twenty past eligible daily sessions; longest training label end strictly before first validation signal
hyperparameters_selected_from: One declared residual hypothesis after V3 failure; fixed parameters, no sweep
evaluation_status: Previously inspected 2026 research history, not a new untouched test set
